name: anti-slop
description: Fewer narrating comments and fewer stock phrases: nudges Claude right after an edit that piles on comments, and keeps "load-bearing" and "You're absolutely right" out of its replies.

comments.title: Comment nudges
comments.description: nudge tells Claude, right after an edit, to remove comments that restate the code or narrate the change; off does nothing. Edits are never refused.

minComments.title: Comment lines before a nudge
minComments.description: An edit is nudged when it adds at least this many comment lines (and the share below). A comment narrating the change is nudged at once.

commentPercent.title: Share of comment lines (%)
commentPercent.description: …and they are at least this percent of the lines the edit added.

phrases.title: Phrases
phrases.description: Comma-separated. "phrase=>replacement" rewrites it in stored replies; "phrase=>" drops it; a bare phrase is only asked to be avoided.
phrases.default: load-bearing=>critical, You're absolutely right=>, You are absolutely right=>

rewrite.title: Rewrite stored replies
rewrite.description: Apply the replacements to the reply as the conversation keeps it, so Claude does not keep echoing the phrase.
